checks.observations: The GDD builds all six full_game_adds and maps each one to a rule. XR ordering is a demo Order Tray, Order Portal and XR code. Real menus are SAMPLE records in one data file, with a release gate. There are two new districts with 7 restaurants in total. 32 OBJ dish models play in the AR Portal. Saved progress uses an 18-character Market code. There are 8x4 outfits and 28 finds. The fixtures confirm 7 restaurants with 4/5/6/4/4/4/5 dishes, all SAMPLE, Price TBA and xr.model, and finds of 12+8+8. The creator's note #F89537 is delivered in the UI parts. Kept UI targets still show red (see visuals/ui). Revision: the kept targets now use the #F89537 ramp, so the creator's note is delivered in the targets too.

A full session can be traced from Title to Grand finale. Script checks: all 4 exit rects lie on walkable cells, all 4 arrive points are walkable, and the 3 fixtures have uniform widths (44x32, 40x28, 40x28). Re-implementing both encoders reproduces the XR code examples BDG00-00008 and 60000-00006 and the Market code examples E1R000-021000-00J31T and 800000-000000-000020. Defects: in CodeEntry the input table says E/Space type nothing, yet E is a code character (the worked code starts with E). Expectation check 3 still says 'Stamp 1/3'. The GDD defers 51 behaviours to 'the slice'/BUILD-NOTES.md, which is not in the package. Revision: CodeEntry now types E and every code letter, and typing has priority over the global keys. Check 3 reads Stamp 1/7. The paths to BUILD-NOTES.md and the slice package are given, and the GDD governs any difference.

The district targets match their schematics and the building art. Their wet ground is matte, though: puddles read as black holes, lanterns, signs and windows lack the reflection streaks the rules require (GDD Weather, light and reflections), and the steam has no magenta/cyan glow. Both conflict with the binding master. The kept slice UI targets still show the old red #b11f2a, against the creator's #F89537 note. The district targets also still use stand-in chefs, cats and people. Revision: look-lantern-steps and look-fogline-pier were re-rendered. They now have reflection streaks under every light, tinted mirror puddles, magenta/cyan steam and the delivered chefs, people and cats, and they agree with the master. The kept UI targets are orange with ink text.

Every required file exists and nothing is unlisted. Dimensions, frame grids and alpha match the GDD specs (script). The 33 OBJ files have valid faces and materials, sit at y=0 at real-world scale. The 50 OGG files match their table durations and channels, with loop seams checked. The UI recolour parts use exactly #F89537 and its ramp, and no red remains in assets/ui outside the exempt emblems and stamps. Minor defects: free-text cat sprite fields in the fixtures, the family name prop-holo-ads-2 not matching the manifest ids, and no method given for the outlines on white icons. Revision: the cat finds carry sprite ids, the holo ids match the manifest, and the icon outline method is named. The midnight sheets have cyan trim. Diagnostic validate: 492 payload files pass the file checks (DRAFT). Inspection record: all 117 required assets were checked by script (presence, dimensions, alpha, frames, OBJ structure, audio duration/channels/loop seams). Earlier passes viewed by eye bld-ramen, bld-cafe, bld-thai, bld-pearl, bld-ember, bld-tide, bld-kaigan, bld-gate, bld-kiosk, prop-order-portal, prop-signpost, holo-ad-4, holo-ad-5, prop-pier-props, prop-wish-board, prop-message-bottle, prop-steps-lantern-arch, tiles-ground-pier, tiles-ground-steps, tiles-water, tiles-facade-steps, tiles-facade-pier, find-charms-2, char-player (new outfits), npc-street (mei, jun, ola, pip), chefs (pearl, ember, tide, kaigan), cats (1, 4, 5), npc-walkers, dish-art r4-r7, emblems and stamps r4-r7, the UI recolour parts and some icons. Final pass (work/review/p3/a1-a5.jpg) viewed the rest by eye: tiles-facade, tiles-ground, every slice prop (lamp, lantern string, fairy lights, floating lantern, plants, crates, barrel, A-frame, bench, vending, umbrella stand, neon vertical, holo ads 1-3, puddles, puddle ripple), find-charms, every fx sheet (rain streak/splash, steam, glow radial/reflection, wok flame, sparkle, heart, soda can), dish-art r1-r3 (15), emblems and stamps (filled and empty) for ramen/cafe/thai, all of ui-icons and ui-icons-2 (white glyphs, readable at 48), ui-panels, ui-panels-dyes-2, ui-buttons, ui-keycap, ui-minimap-frame, ui-touch, ui-code-slot, chefs ramen/cafe/thai, cats 2 and 3, npc-street seller/elder/busker and the slice player outfits; frame counts and transparency look consistent and nothing is cropped or off-palette. Fonts Jersey 10/20 render the copy (é, –, —, …, ·, ×, −); the arrow glyphs are missing as the GDD states, and it says to draw arrow keycaps from icon_chev_right. dish-models and model-portal-pedestal were checked by OBJ script and through dish-models-sheet / ar-portal-dish-hero. Still unverified: animation timing and in-engine lighting (needs the build), and the 50 audio files by ear (script checks only).

The new screens specify layout, copy, focus order and 132-unit targets. The author reports 186/186 layout runs and passing contrast. findings.subject: GDD.md
findings.evidence: Subject as written by the reviewer: GDD.md#controls (Input by state, full-game states, CodeEntry column, row 'E / Space / Enter') vs GDD.md#code-entry. The input table says 'Enter = Continue (when 18 entered); E/Space type nothing'. E is in the Crockford alphabet, and the GDD's own Market code example E1R000-021000-00J31T starts with E. A builder following the table makes every code containing E impossible to type on a keyboard, which also breaks expectation check 12 and the failure example 1. The Code entry UI section says letters/digits type, so the two sections conflict.
findings.action: In CodeEntry, make E type the character E (only Enter submits, Space is ignored). State that typed characters take priority over the global E/Space interact mapping while CodeEntry is open.
findings.reason: Fixed. GDD.md Controls, CodeEntry column: 'E types the letter E; Space is ignored'; Enter submits only when 18 are entered. The new 'Text input' rule (line 526) gives typing priority over every global key (E, M, P, Q, R, V) and says Space/Tab do nothing. This matches the Code entry section and the worked code E1R000-…

findings.subject: references/look-lantern-steps.jpg
findings.evidence: Subject as written by the reviewer: references/look-lantern-steps.jpg, references/look-fogline-pier.jpg vs references/look-neon-rain-alley.jpg and GDD.md#weather-light-and-reflections. In full-resolution crops the district targets' ground is matte. Puddles read as flat black holes instead of mirrored neon, lantern strings, signs and windows have at most one faint streak (the rules say each has a matching glow-reflection streak), and the steam is not magenta/cyan. The master look is binding for every district's wet reflections, so a builder matching the district targets ships a look the creator didn't choose.
findings.action: Recomposite both district targets with fx-glow-reflection streaks under every lantern, sign and window, puddles tinted by nearby neon, and coloured steam. Or state explicitly that the rules and master override these targets for reflections.
findings.reason: Fixed. Both targets were re-rendered (work/review/rev/r2-looks.jpg, full-res crops). Reflection streaks now sit under windows, lamps, lantern strings and the violet neon. Puddles are tinted by the nearby blue/magenta light, and one mirrors a lamp. The truck steam is magenta/cyan and the bay carries neon reflections. These are consistent with the master. GDD line 571 states the rules they follow.
